why: A June 2026 preprint by Kothari and Tudose, "On Brouwer's Laplacian conjecture" (arXiv:2606.12197), claims a full proof of Brouwer's conjecture via equivalence with the Grone-Merris-Bai theorem for split graphs; a related July 2026 paper (arXiv:2607.03388) discusses equality cases, consistent with a proof having landed.
